messages.author: Wout
messages.text: Start a deep, hypnotic techno set at 126 bpm

turn.plan: Start a deep hypnotic techno set at 126 bpm with a 909 kick, offbeat bass and a filtered hat layer, in A minor for a dark feel.
turn.reply: Wout, the set is starting at 126 bpm in A minor with kick, sub bass and hats, and the hats filter in after 4 bars.
turn.summary: Initial deep techno set at 126 bpm

outcome.reply: Wout, the set is starting at 126 bpm in A minor with kick, sub bass and hats, and the hats filter in after 4 bars.

messages.author: autopilot
messages.text: mutation: give the rhythm of "kick" a new twist: a vary, or a new pattern with some syncopation.

turn.plan: Energy is above target, so I'll thin the kick with a syncopated ghost feel and filter the hats down to pull energy back.
turn.reply: Autopilot: thinning the kick and easing the hats.

outcome.reply: Autopilot: thinning the kick and easing the hats.

messages.author: autopilot
messages.text: mutation: change the colour of "sub" over 8 to 32 bars with automate (a filter, room, delay or shape).

turn.plan: Slowly darken the sub bass with a filter sweep over 16 bars to fit the warm-up energy.
turn.reply: Autopilot: darkening the sub bass slowly.

outcome.reply: Autopilot: darkening the sub bass slowly.

messages.author: Wout
messages.text: more groove, it feels too straight

turn.plan: Add swing to the groove and offset the hats with a light shuffle plus a ghost variation, keeping the energy in the warm-up phase.
turn.reply: Wout, I added a light swing and ghost hits to the hats for more groove.
turn.summary: Add swing and hat ghost notes

outcome.reply: Wout, I added a light swing and ghost hits to the hats for more groove.

messages.author: autopilot
messages.text: mutation: change the bassline "sub" a little: other notes or another rhythm, with the same root and groove.

turn.plan: Autopilot mutation: shift the sub bass into a syncopated pattern on the same A root, keeping the groove and warm-up energy.
turn.reply: Autopilot: syncopating the sub bass a little.

outcome.reply: Autopilot: syncopating the sub bass a little.

turn.plan: Build phase: add a percussion layer and open the hat filter in stages to raise energy toward the peak.
turn.reply: Autopilot, percussion comes in and the hats open up over the next phrases.
turn.summary: Build: add rim percussion, open hats

outcome.reply: Autopilot, percussion comes in and the hats open up over the next phrases.

messages.author: autopilot
messages.text: mutation: add one small new layer (a texture, percussion or a short stab) that fades or filters in.

turn.plan: Replace the unknown shaker sound with the allowed shaker_small sample, keeping the same soft fade-in and easing the rim.
turn.reply: Autopilot: adding a soft shaker and easing the rim.

outcome.reply: Autopilot: adding a soft shaker and easing the rim.

messages.author: Wout
messages.text: build it up, open the filters

turn.plan: Build the tension for Wout by opening the filters over 16 bars and easing the rim back a touch. Energy is already above target, so only subtle opening moves.
turn.reply: Wout, the filters open over the next 16 bars, the bass and hats getting brighter while the build keeps rising.
turn.summary: Build: open sub and hat filters

outcome.reply: Wout, the filters open over the next 16 bars, the bass and hats getting brighter while the build keeps rising.

turn.plan: Move from Build to Peak: bring in a driving bass and clap, raise the energy toward 7.5 by opening the sub bass filter and adding a stab on the next phrase.
turn.reply: Autopilot: Peak push in, clap and stabs arrive.

outcome.reply: Autopilot: Peak push in, clap and stabs arrive.

messages.author: autopilot
messages.text: mutation: give the rhythm of "kick" a new twist: a vary, or a new pattern with some syncopation.

turn.plan: Give the kick a syncopated twist with a fill on every 4th bar, lifting the energy toward the peak target without removing anything.
turn.reply: Autopilot: kick gets a syncopated fill now.
turn.summary: Kick syncopation and fills at peak

outcome.reply: Autopilot: kick gets a syncopated fill now.

turn.plan: Wout asks for the breakdown. I will set the phase to breakdown and take the kick and sub bass out with a filter over 4 bars, so the groove drops and the pads and stabs carry the room.
turn.reply: Wout, going to the breakdown: the kick and sub bass filter out over the next phrase, and the stabs and percussion carry the space.
turn.summary: Breakdown: kick and sub filter out

outcome.reply: Wout, going to the breakdown: the kick and sub bass filter out over the next phrase, and the stabs and percussion carry the space.

messages.author: autopilot
messages.text: mutation: make space: take "shaker" out for a while with a fade or a filter (muted: true), or thin it.

turn.plan: Breakdown needs more space, so I'll thin the hats and take the shaker out with a filter sweep.
turn.reply: Autopilot: making space now, shaker fades out.

outcome.reply: Autopilot: making space now, shaker fades out.
